name.ja: BB戦士323 黄忠ガンダム

ja: 新章「戦神決闘編」二人目の武将、弓の達人“黄忠ガンダム”出陣！ 黄忠ガンダムに支援メカが合体、更に連龍形態（れんりゅうけいたい）、龍鱗形態（りゅうりんけいたい）に組み換え可能 鎧は着脱可能、軽装形態も再現 刀、盾、弓、矢×3本が付属
en: The second military commander in the new chapter “War God Duel Edition”, the archery expert “Hwang Zhong Gundam”, goes to battle! A support mecha is combined with Huang Chung Gundam, and it can be further recombined into Renryu Keitai form and Dragon Scale form. Armor is removable, and light armor form is also reproduced. Sword, shield, bow, and 3 arrows are included.
